y1: Jesus didn't ride a fancy horse, but a little donkey into Jerusalem. He is a humble King.
y2: People spread their coats and tree branches on the road and shouted, “Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”
y4: Jesus went into the temple, but instead of praying, people were buying, selling, and making a lot of noise.
y5: Jesus overturned the tables and said, “My house will be called a house of prayer, but you are making it a den of robbers!”
y7: In the temple, the blind and the lame came to Jesus, and He healed them. The children shouted with joy, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”
y8: The chief priests were angry, but Jesus said, “Have you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies you have prepared praise’?” God is pleased with the praise of children.
y10: In the morning, Jesus was hungry. He went up to a fig tree, but it only had leaves and not a single fruit. As soon as Jesus spoke to it, the tree dried up.
y11: Jesus said, “You shouldn't just look good on the outside without having any fruit. If you pray with faith, you will receive whatever you ask for.”
verse: “Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
prayer: Jesus, I praise You for being the humble King who came riding on a donkey. Hosanna! Let my heart also be a house of prayer. Help me to praise You joyfully like the children in the temple, and to be a person who bears good fruit, not just a tree with leaves. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: donkey. A small and slow animal, smaller than a horse. It is a symbol of peace. Jesus rode a donkey.
d1: hosanna. A joyful shout that means “Save now!” The people shouted hosanna.
d2: temple. A large building in Jerusalem where people worshipped God. The temple is a house of prayer.
d3: praise. To lift up, sing to, and say good things about God. God is pleased with the praise of children.
d4: fig tree. A tree that grows sweet fig fruits. The fig tree only had leaves.
